articles.title: US widens AI chip export restrictions to cover additional data-center accelerators
articles.summary: The Commerce Department expanded license requirements to a broader class of AI accelerators, including parts previously designed to fall under performance thresholds. Analysts estimate the affected markets accounted for a low-double-digit share of recent data-center revenue at the largest US vendors.

articles.title: NVIDIA schedules Q3 earnings for 18 November, guides to continued data-center strength
articles.summary: NVIDIA confirmed its next earnings date and reiterated that data-center demand remains supply-constrained rather than demand-constrained.

articles.title: ASML books record order intake as leading-edge lithography demand accelerates
articles.summary: ASML reported bookings ahead of consensus, driven by high-NA EUV commitments from two logic customers, and nudged its full-year outlook higher.

articles.title: Microsoft raises cloud capex guidance, says AI capacity remains the binding constraint
articles.summary: Microsoft told investors capital expenditure will step up again next quarter, with the majority going to AI datacenter capacity.

articles.title: Fed holds rates steady, signals patience as inflation drifts sideways
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve left policy unchanged and removed language implying near-term cuts, describing progress on inflation as having stalled.

articles.title: Local bakery chain expands to three new towns
articles.summary: A regional bakery announced expansion plans funded by a bank loan. No public market exposure.

articles.title: NVIDIA shares slip 1.2% in premarket trading
articles.summary: Shares edged lower in thin premarket volume with no company-specific news.

articles.title: Football transfer window closes with record spending
articles.summary: Clubs spent a record sum during the summer window.
